BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the purchase of 49,600 ordinary shares between July 27 and July 31, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The weighted average price for these shares was 1,999.37 pence, with the highest price paid being 2,036.00 pence and the lowest at 1,969.00 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 112,974,385. This action is in line with the company's previously announced buyback program. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 31 July 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 31 July 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 27 July 2026 up to and including 31 July 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 27 July 2026 10,000 1,993.00 1,969.00 1,978.64 XLON 28 July 2026 10,000 2,006.00 1,974.00 1,989.91 XLON 29 July 2026 10,000 2,006.00 1,985.00 1,997.04 XLON 30 July 2026 9,800 2,024.00 1,992.00 2,014.63 XLON 31 July 2026 9,800 2,036.00 2,000.00 2,017.27 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 3,375,823 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 6,334,139 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 112,974,385 ordinary shares.
